per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Pages for routine interactions (e.g. loading a movie detail or moving between pages) shall respond within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial video stream startup (time to first frame/playback start) shall be no more than 10 seconds under normal network conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Pages shall be lightweight and optimized to load well on low-bandwidth connections.
Monitoring must detect slow pages or streams and alert operations so they can react before customers complain; daily usage metrics must be produced for trend detection.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Every sale shall be recorded and auditable; admins must be able to access sales/usage data via dashboard and downloadable reports without engineering intervention.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Financial records and logs shall be retained long enough to satisfy auditors and local tax rules; usage analytics daily aggregates shall be retained for at least months for trend analysis.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Payment card data shall be stored and handled such that unauthorized employees cannot view card numbers; data must be encrypted and access limited to a small set of authorized roles.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Only specific authorised roles (senior finance, a very small number of platform ops, possibly a security officer) shall have access to sensitive payment records; customer service and marketing shall not have such access.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: For high-risk actions (e.g., unlocking raw payment data or refunds above a threshold), additional approvals (e.g., two-person approval) shall be required.

When a payment gateway is unavailable, the site shall remain operational for browsing and redemption of pre-paid cards; purchases may be queued for later processing without storing sensitive card data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Pre-paid card redemptions shall be processed immediately on our side and must not depend on the external payment gateway.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: If the streaming service degrades or a streaming server goes down, the site shall continue to allow browsing and purchases; playback shall present clear messaging and attempt automatic retry or use fallback streams to preserve viewing for most users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Some small fraction of users may be affected in an outage, but widespread outages are unacceptable; priority shall be given to paying customers mid-playback and to critical admin functions during degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: System planning shall support approximately 1,000 simultaneous users at peak.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The server will support a maximum of 1 000 simultaneous users.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The service shall target 99.5% availability for planning and stakeholder expectations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall achieve 99.5% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Operations must retain audit logs and records sufficient to reconcile sales and support refund disputes; accesses and changes to payment data must be logged for traceability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Privacy notices shall be clearly accessible (a link visible on every page) with a short summary during signup/payment and full policy available immediately if requested.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to customer data shall support regional restrictions and data residency controls to comply with local privacy laws.
Admins shall be able to slice sales and usage data by title, date, and payment type through self-serve interfaces.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: System observability must include daily rolls of usage metrics (who watched what, how many streams started) and produce reports usable by marketing and ops.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product shall present clear, user-friendly messaging during errors or degraded conditions (e.g., streaming failures) and maintain trust without exposing sensitive system details.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall preserve purchases made during partial outages (e.g., streaming or payment gateway failures) so users do not lose entitlement to purchased titles.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Operational dashboards and alerts shall allow ops and business teams to react quickly to anomalies (slowdowns, vendor failures) before customers complain.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'
